attempts.plan: The legacy code has multiple critical flaws: it uses system default timezone instead of fixed Europe/Warsaw, uses non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat, misses the Jan 6 holiday, incorrectly calculates days late using milliseconds (breaking at DST transitions), has broken month-end logic in addMonths, and doesn't validate invalid dates. I'll rewrite the implementation using java.time API which is thread-safe and handles timezones correctly, ensuring all calculations happen in Europe/Warsaw time.
